title: Write the statement of employment terms for an Australian casual retail assistant
person: The store manager of a Brisbane bike shop putting on a casual weekend assistant.

occupation.name: First-Line Supervisors of Retail Sales Workers

review: Casual employment for Mia Thompson as retail assistant from 14/11/2026 under the General Retail Industry Award 2020, $31.85 an hour including the casual loading, paid weekly by EFT; rostered weekends; leave and notice as the NES provide; super to her chosen fund; the Fair Work and Casual Employment Information Statements named; A4.
revised_review: She becomes part-time from 1 February 2027 at 20 hours a week; the casual statement is no longer needed.
